spanish: Y esta *es* la ley de la ofrenda: acercarán a ella hijos de Aarón delante de Jehová, a faces del altar.

findings.issue: Hiphil infinitive absolute has no person or tense; acercarán makes it future 3pl. Plural subject hijos licenses person and number; future tense is Spanish smoothing.

notes: Marked *es* only supplies the verbless copula; delante de and a faces keep both 6440 phrases.
